question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**level**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**level**'.
 
• It means **"at the same height as someone or something else."** (किसी के समान ऊँचाई पर)
 
 
• *Example: The 1997 budget deficit remained at the same **level** as in 1996. *
 
 
 
• One of the principal's main concerns was that all window shades should at the same height.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Paragraph:__* "During my first year of teaching, I was quite (1) __upset__ to find that the school principal, supervisor and teachers (2) __appeared__ to be unaware of their professional responsibilities and (3) __incompetent__ in executing their duties. For example, my principal's main (4) **__concerns__ **were that all window shades be at the same (5) __**level**__, the classrooms be quiet and the rose beds should not be stepped upon."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Grade**: the quality or the level of ability, importance, etc. that somebody/something has. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की योग्‍यता, महत्ता आदि का स्‍तर या गुणवत्ता; श्रेणी)
 
• **Layer**: a thickness or quantity of something that is on something else or between other things. (परत, तह)
 
• **Stage**: one part of the progress or development of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की प्रगति या विकास का एक अंश; चरण, अवस्‍था)
